segmente.text: The problem is, they confuse it with telling their own story.
They talk about how they started, what they built, and why they are different.
But your customer doesn't care about your story.
They only care about their story.
The moment your brand gets into the background, and the customer becomes the hero,
Your product is not the destination, it's the tool.
Stop telling your journey, and start telling your customer's story.
Because the story they see themselves in, is the one they remember.
